name: ÆEA Trading Bot
description: Quantum-Financial Topology Trading Bot on Telegram — MQL4-Parity + MT4/TradingView TWA Edition (Final Edition 3 — Audit-Patched, v4.6.0 + CS-Translated UI: Kraken is the primary crypto provider, Stooq is the primary equities/futures provider, Yahoo is the primary forex/indices provider, live-triple-pruned crypto universe, class-share Stooq fix, ADX single-count fix, six new defect resolutions P-1 through P-4 plus A-C1, A-C2, A-C3, A-M6, A-m1, A-m3; carries forward v4.5.8 vFinal Edition 2 with C-2/C-3/M-1/M-2/M-3/M-4/m-2/m-4/m-5/m-6, v4.5.7 Audit-Patched with D-64..D-81, v4.5.6 Expanded-Universe with E-17..E-24, v4.5.5 with V-1/V-2, v4.5.0 with E-14/E-15/E-16 and D-49..D-54, v4.4.2 Send-Hardened with reply-target hardening + Markdown escaping + plain-text final fallback, v4.4.1 Await-Corrected async send, v4.4.0 Scroll-Ahead execution-gated projection + scroll-ahead viewport to the projected TP + bot replies threaded to the user's last command + bounded push dispatch + FVG merge + legend stacking, v4.3.0 Enhancement Telegram push on every signal/execution/FVG/close + arc-length future price projection, and the v4.2.0 semantics-restored baseline)

TELEGRAM_WEBAPP_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL of the Telegram Mini App (GitHub Pages). Skips tunnel spawn when set.

RELAY_URL.description: Cloudflare Worker relay URL (deployed from the aei-relay repo). Required for live prices.

RELAY_KEY.description: Optional shared secret matching `wrangler secret put RELAY_KEY` in the aei-relay repo.

REQUIRE_AUTH.description: Enforce X-Telegram-Init-Data on all non-/health endpoints. Defaults to '1'.

LOG_BUFFER_SIZE.description: Ring-buffer size for the /log endpoint. Defaults to '1000'.

TOAST_BUFFER_SIZE.description: Ring-buffer size for the /toasts endpoint. Defaults to '500'.

CORS_ORIGIN.description: Lock down writes to your GitHub Pages origin. Defaults to '*'.

UPDATE_INTERVAL.description: Price-feed polling interval in seconds. Defaults to 30.

MAX_MIN_GAP.description: Minimum (max - min). The FF requires 2. Defaults to '2'.

MIN_PERIOD_FLOOR.description: Hard floor on the FF's `min` input. The FF requires 3 (so y = min - 2 >= 1). Defaults to '3'.

SYMBOL_DIGITS.description: JSON map of symbol → digits for Point-size emulation. Defaults to the built-in v4.6.0 table covering every live crypto pair and every futures/equities/forex/indices symbol.

SYMBOL_DIGITS_DEFAULT.description: Fallback digit count for symbols not in the table. Defaults to '2'.

PUSH_ON_SIGNAL.description: Send a Telegram push on every signal. Defaults to '1'.

PUSH_ON_EXECUTION.description: Send a Telegram push on every execution event. Defaults to '1'.

PUSH_ON_FVG.description: Send a Telegram push on every FVG commit/remove. Defaults to '1'.

PUSH_ON_CLOSE.description: Send a Telegram push on every A()/B() close. Defaults to '1'.

PUSH_DEDUP_WINDOW_MS.description: Suppress a second push for the same logical event within this window (ms). Defaults to '800'.

ARC_PROJECTION_HORIZON.description: Number of forward bars to emit in the arc-length projection. Defaults to '30'.

ARC_PROJECTION_STEP.description: Price step quantization for the emitted path. Defaults to '1'.

ARC_PROJECTION_DAMPING.description: Decay factor for the volatile-regime branch. Must parse as a Decimal in (0, 1); otherwise the process fails fast at module load. Defaults to '0.94'.
